title: A/R Detail and A/R Collection do not remember expanded groups
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Both reports have open documents on today's date in several groups.
  • Starting screen: Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/R Detail (Reports, then "A/R Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) and note which groups are expanded.
  2. Click the chevron on the first bucket row to change it.
  3. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu), then open A/R Detail again.
  4. Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) and note which groups are expanded.
  5. Click the chevron on the first customer group row to change it.
  6. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu), then open A/R Collection again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: A/R Detail opens; note its opening state.
  • Step 2: that bucket changes (expands or collapses).
  • Step 3: A/R Detail opens in the same state as in step 1, not the state you left: the change is not remembered.
  • Step 4: A/R Collection opens; note its opening state.
  • Step 5: that customer group changes (expands or collapses).
  • Step 6: A/R Collection opens in the same state as in step 4, not the state you left: the change is not remembered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R9: “Expanded state is not remembered between visits.”
